external_entities.name: player
external_entities.description: A player who launches the game client and plays through it from a machine the system owner does not control.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

external_entities.name: customer support staff
external_entities.description: Staff who work from the corporate network and use the moderation website to act on player accounts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

processes.name: game client
processes.description: The player-facing game client launched and run on a player's machine.
processes.source_excerpt: The player launches the client and plays through it.

processes.name: lobby
processes.description: The production-network service used for matchmaking and match setup.
processes.source_excerpt: It talks to the lobby on TCP 1234 for matchmaking

processes.name: game server
processes.description: The production-network service that handles matches and updates player and match statistics.
processes.source_excerpt: once a match starts it talks directly to the game servers on TCP 1235

processes.name: moderation website
processes.description: A website used by customer support staff to look at and act on player accounts.
processes.source_excerpt: use a moderation website to look at and act on player accounts

data_stores.name: player database
data_stores.description: A database read by the lobby for match setup, written by game servers, and read and written by the moderation website for player-account actions.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match

data_stores.name: stats database
data_stores.description: A database read and written by the game servers during and after a match.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match

data_flows.name: matchmaking
data_flows.description: The game client connects to the lobby for matchmaking.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It talks to the lobby on TCP 1234 for matchmaking
data_flows.notes: The source says the client link is represented by a port number and does not record authentication.

data_flows.name: play match
data_flows.description: The game client connects directly to the game server once a match starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: once a match starts it talks directly to the game servers on TCP 1235
data_flows.notes: The source says the client link is represented by a port number and does not record authentication.

data_flows.name: set up match
data_flows.description: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match
data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.
data_flows.data_description: player data used to set up a match

data_flows.name: hand off match
data_flows.description: The lobby hands the match over to the game server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: and hands the match over to the game servers
data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.

data_flows.name: update stats
data_flows.description: The game server reads and writes the stats database during and after a match.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match
data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.

data_flows.name: write back
data_flows.description: The game server writes back to the player database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: and they also write back to the player database
data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.

data_flows.name: moderate accounts
data_flows.description: Customer support staff use the moderation website to look at and act on player accounts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network and use a moderation website to look at and act on player accounts
data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.

data_flows.notes: The diagram does not record authentication on this link.
